area: King's Pass, Dirtmouth and the Forgotten Crossroads (to False Knight and Vengeful Spirit; Greenpath's first two rooms and the Crystal Peak toll room as exits)
sources: files: Hollow Knight (Steam, Mac build, Unity 6000.0.61f1) read with UnityPy + type trees generated from Managed/*.dll (tools/reference/mined/hollow-knight/extract.py -> rooms.py -> build.py): scene sizes (tk2dTileMap), every collider, TransitionPoints, HealthManager / DamageHero, PlayMakerFSM names and variables, the camera and the knight
mined: RandomizerMod (homothetyhk) door table, room table and logic: exits, one-ways, gates (what each door needs)
mined: TangledMapView mapData.js (sirbrialliance): door, item and bench positions in each scene's own units
wiki: hollowknight.wiki enemy/boss pages (datamined HP, behaviour), Nail (5 damage), SOUL (11 per hit, 33 per cast), Focus pages
estimate: hidden-item descriptions, difficulty ratings, play minutes, hero box and jump height (marked per field)
mined: hallownest-calculator (betorzdev) only as a cross-check of room sizes and enemy counts

units.how: files: the game camera (resources.assets _GameCameras/CameraParent/tk2dCamera) is a perspective tk2dCamera, vertical FOV 24 deg, at z -38.1, native 1920x1080; the knight and the terrain are at z 0, so the view there is 2*38.1*tan(12 deg) = 16.197 u tall and 28.795 u wide (16:9). Our 1920 px view = 28.795 u: 1 HK unit = 66.68 of our px. (The sprites are authored at 64 px per unit, so HK draws them at 1.04x on a 1080p screen.)

hero.runSrc: files: HeroController.RUN_SPEED 8.3 u/s (WALK 6, dash 20 u/s for 0.25 s)
hero.jumpSrc: files + computed: JUMP_SPEED 16.65 u/s held for JUMP_STEPS 9 physics steps (0.02 s, min 4), then gravity 60 x DEFAULT_GRAVITY 0.79 = 47.4 u/s2; full hold rises 5.27 u. MAX_FALL_VELOCITY 20 u/s
startAbilities: nail (old nail: 5 damage, ~0.41 s cooldown, horizontal, up and down slash; down-slash pogo off enemies/spikes)
focus (33 soul = heal 1 mask in ~1.14 s)
run, variable jump, fall-through nothing; no dash, no wall-climb, no double jump

notes: enemies: one entry per individual present on a first visit (positions, hp and damage from the files); battle waves that wait off-screen are put at the arena centre (atIsArenaCentre)
enemiesLater: infected-Crossroads variants (after the first Dreamer / Monarch Wings), Gruz Mother's brood, inactive-at-load and 2%-chance enemies; not in the metrics
terrain solid = the real colliders (layer 8 Terrain, non-trigger, enabled, active at load): edge loops from the tile map, polygons and boxes
terrain secretWall = the dark masks that hide a room until you step in (unmasker FSM; the mask sprite's bounds, else its reveal trigger)
terrain breakable = breakable walls / floors, the dive floor, collapsing floors (their colliders); hazard = DamageHero hazardType 2 (spikes) / 3 (acid)
the room graph (which door leads where) and what each door / item needs are the randomizer's tables (mined); everything with a position is from the files
insets: Ancestral Mound, Black Egg Temple, Salubra's shop and Sly's hut are entered by background doors; they are drawn in a row below the map, not in place
boundary rooms (Greenpath x2, Crystal Peak toll) are drawn but excluded from the metrics
